description: Query C/C++ symbols, definitions, references, includes and static call candidates with libclang 18; needs a compile_commands.json. Compiler commands never execute; workspace files are permission-filtered, read through a redirect-only VFS. One-based UTF-16 coordinates, with source digests and partial coverage. File-level edges come from a static include scan only; system and git-ignored headers are unresolved. One target platform per database.
